entries.title: 2007: China Airlines Flight 120 catches fire and explodes after landing at Naha Airport in Okinawa, Japan.
entries.summary: China Airlines Flight 120 was a regularly scheduled international flight from Taoyuan International Airport in Taoyuan County, Taiwan to Naha Airport in Okinawa Prefecture, Japan.
